landing.faq.answer1: We pull global market exchange rates automatically. Whenever you add a transaction in a currency different from your base currency, the system calculates and preserves the exact converted amount.
landing.faq.answer2: Yes. Your records are protected with database-level Row Level Security policies. Only your authenticated user account can view, modify, or export your ledger.
landing.faq.question3: Does the application support Arabic and RTL?
landing.faq.answer3: Absolutely. The entire platform features complete bilingual and multi-lingual RTL layouts with native translations for Arabic, Urdu, and over 18 other languages.
landing.hero.badge: Quản lý Dòng tiền & Tài sản Thế hệ Mới
landing.features.sectionTitle: Everything you need to master your money
landing.features.sectionDesc: Built with precision engineering, bank-grade encryption, and real-time global foreign exchange calculations.
landing.features.f1Desc: Effortlessly visualize your monthly and yearly net savings. Spot trends before they impact your balance sheets.
landing.features.f2Desc: Record transactions in any world currency. All balances are automatically recalculated into your preferred base currency.
landing.features.f3Desc: Create custom color-coded categories. Break down exactly what percentage of income goes into housing, investments, or leisure.
landing.features.f4Desc: End-to-end data encryption and Supabase Row Level Security ensure only you ever have access to your financial records.
landing.features.f5Desc: Log transactions on the go. Designed with high-performance responsive layouts for quick ledger entry anywhere.
landing.features.f6Desc: Native support for English, Arabic, Urdu, Chinese, Japanese, and more with full right-to-left layout alignment.
landing.analytics.title: Understand your net worth with real-time analytics
landing.analytics.desc: Gain continuous clarity over your spending patterns. Our adaptive analytics engine groups transaction volumes by timeframe, tags, and currencies so you never miss an anomaly.
landing.analytics.item1Desc: Compare this month against previous quarters or custom date ranges at a single glance.
landing.analytics.item2Desc: Every ledger record is converted instantly based on authenticated international exchange benchmarks.
landing.audiences.title: Made for individuals, freelancers & companies alike
landing.audiences.freelancerDesc: Track earnings from international clients in USD, EUR, or GBP without worrying about manual conversion calculations.
landing.audiences.individualDesc: Know exactly how much you save every month and achieve your financial freedom goals with ease.
landing.audiences.businessDesc: Oversee company burn rate, operational expenses, and recurring revenue streams in real time.
landing.security.title: Your security and privacy come first
landing.security.desc: Every query, amount, and conversion is isolated and safeguarded with modern cloud cryptography.
landing.security.f1Desc: All records stored with industry-leading TLS 1.3 in transit and AES-256 at rest.
landing.security.f2Desc: Database-enforced isolation guarantees your transactions can never be queried by other users.
landing.security.f3Desc: Direct integration with authoritative global foreign exchange datasets with zero tampering.
landing.faq.title: Some questions, some answers.
